question: In a certain code language, 'TULIPS' is written as ‘GFORKH’. How will 'GARDEN' be written in that language?
solution:
The position of letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/AWFm0GXpwUnXMk5abPs_gn5WQJWmMu6pCjsj_IZrF5d9DiHGDiNZGMVyTE_BZ3grk8NYWpZO51MbOo8TBDEELNeRBEi5Nr3v2R_a3A_jaoe6pVjFZqIPEhySRdVJuwA9DeJF68qAdP_UClBqUwpHxw] 

'TULIPS' is written as ‘GFORKH’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/12fa79daded3a84772a7ab0e07a79ea0b71e7321521010593f6dfe2c56a5ddba.png] 

Similarly, 

'GARDEN' be written as '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7e2574be094709d6296787a4eac43ff091eb0aef41bd156e776458e995e2d81a.png] 

Hence, the correct answer **"TZIWVM".**
